howTo: Check each claim against the company's own public pages and set verdict to "right", "wrong" or "unsure" (for a missing claim, "right" means the pages really do not say it; "unsure" means the pages do not settle it, and it never counts as right); write why in note, the pages you read in checkedUrls, your name in checkedBy and the day in checkedOn.

claims.value: IT consulting company founded in Karlskrona, Sweden delivering software development, system integration, cloud services, AI automation and embedded programming to Swedish authorities and companies

evidence.quote: Malvacom AB är ett IT-konsultbolag grundat i Karlskrona, Blekinge, Sverige. Bolaget levererar mjukvaruutveckling, systemintegration, molntjänster, AI-automation och embedded-programmering till svenska myndigheter och företag.

claims.note: Word for word in 'Om bolaget' on malvacom.com.

evidence.quote: Malvacom erbjuder sex specialisttjänster — från nyutveckling och AI-automation till systemintegration, drift och långsiktig förvaltning.

claims.note: malvacom.com: 'från nyutveckling och AI-automation till systemintegration, drift och långsiktig förvaltning'. Incomplete: cloud services and embedded/IoT, two of the six services, are left out.

evidence.quote: Teknik: Python, Django, Javascript, .NET, PostgreSQL, MSSQL, PHP, Jira, Git

claims.note: All nine are on malvacom.com: the UKÄ case lists exactly these, and the FAQ's technology list has all but Jira (Jira is in the customer cases). Incomplete: React, TypeScript, C# and Azure are left out.

Not missing: malvacom.com says what its work is used for, e.g. AI for document handling, information search and decision processes, integrations between HR, payroll, authority registers and IoT, customer portals and fire-alarm monitoring.

Not missing: malvacom.com serves 'svenska myndigheter och företag' and 'offentlig sektor och näringsliv'; the FAQ names customers in offentlig sektor, fastighetsteknik, energi, industri, säkerhetssystem och rekrytering.

Not missing: malvacom.com has offices in Karlskrona (head office), Karlshamn and Stockholm and says 'Geografisk räckvidd: Karlskrona, Blekinge, hela Sverige och Norden'. The profile's own summary says founded in Karlskrona.

Not missing: malvacom.com describes its projects and collaborations (UKÄ, Vasakronan, the Nexans program built with JK Cablegrid Consulting, the Alphalab innovation lab) and its aim of long-term management ('Malvacoms affärsmodell bygger på långsiktig förvaltning').

Not missing: a reasonable reader can infer partner and funding interests from malvacom.com, e.g. AI and agent work, startups and industry partners for the Alphalab lab, and 'Projekt inom energi, proptech och marinteknik'.
